chunks: We shall turn their hearts and their eyes, for they did not believe them at the very first, and leave them to wander perplexed in bewilderment.

key_terms.أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ: their hearts (plural of fad'ah, referring to the inner seat of understanding)

ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers remain confused and unable to accept the truth according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the divine mechanism of *tadlil* (causing to err) as a consequence of human free will, where persistent rejection hardens the heart and blinds the eye. It highlights that the disbelievers' confusion is not merely external but an internal spiritual state resulting from their initial refusal to acknowledge the truth, leaving them wandering in *taghiyah* (arrogant deviation).
